data.one_liner: Dart implementation of TweetNaCl cryptographic library with high-level APIs
data.what_it_does: Provides authenticated encryption, digital signatures, hashing, and key derivation using Curve25519 and Ed25519. It wraps TweetNaCl functions into Dart-friendly classes and methods.
use_when: You need fast, auditable cryptography in a pure Dart app
Implementing secure messaging or key exchange
Deriving keys from passwords with PBKDF2
avoid_when: You need platform-specific native crypto APIs for performance
You require integration with existing native libraries like OpenSSL
strengths: Supports multiple cryptographic primitives (Box, SealedBox, SecretBox, Ed25519, HMAC, SHA-256/512, BLAKE2b)
Cross-platform (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: No native acceleration, may be slower than platform libs
Large feature set may be overkill for simple use cases
No built-in key storage or secure enclave integration
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package:pinenacl/api.dart
